common.guild_only: 🚫 Commands only work inside a server — CHRONOS has no DM features.
common.duplicate_delivery: ✅ That command already completed — this was a duplicate delivery, nothing re-run.
common.access_denied:
🚫 **Access Denied.**

Slash commands can only be used by **Admin/Staff**.

If you believe this is a mistake, contact a server admin.
common.unmapped_command: ⚠️ Command `{command}` is not supported by the router yet. Contact the dev.
common.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.error_discord_api: Discord API error. Please try again in a moment.
common.missing_permissions: I lack the required permissions for this action. Check my role position and permissions.

help.description: Help center: pick a category or search commands by keyword

options.search: Keyword of the command to search (e.g. key, escrow, panel)

setup-ticket.description: Set up the ticket panel & price list

set-role.description: Set roles (verified / unverified / admin / midman / booster)

set-channel.description: Set channels (invoice / welcome / goodbye / audit-log / server-log / transcript / server-booster)

test-welcome.description: Diagnose & preview the welcome/goodbye embed (find out why it does not appear)

set-message.description: Edit the welcome / goodbye / verify / ticket embed text

set-verify-button.description: Customize the verification button (label, emoji, style)

add-category.description: Add a new ticket category (for dynamic ticket panels)

options.label: Button label (max 80 chars)
options.requires_key: Does this category need the Set Key button? (default: true)

remove-category.description: Remove a ticket category from the config

update-category.description: Edit an existing ticket category (label/emoji/style/requires_key) without delete+re-add

options.label: New button label (max 80 chars)
options.requires_key: Does this category need the Set Key button?

setup-ticket-panel.description: Set up a ticket panel with full customization (multi-panel support)

options.title: Embed title (overrides global). Leave empty = use config default
options.categories: Comma-separated category IDs to display (leave empty = all)
options.color: Hex color (e.g. #ff5733 or #fff). Leave empty = default orange
options.image: Large image URL (https://...). Leave empty = no image
options.thumbnail: Small thumbnail URL (https://...). Leave empty = no thumbnail
options.footer: Footer text. Leave empty = use the bot name
options.channel: Target channel (default: current channel). Must be a text channel
options.use_dropdown: TRUE = use a dropdown select menu (default: FALSE = buttons)

list-panels.description: View all persistent ticket panels on this server

delete-panel.description: Delete a ticket panel by ID (auto-deletes message + metadata)

refresh-panel.description: Re-render a panel with the latest categories/products (no re-setup needed)

update-panel.description: Edit a panel field (title/body/color/image/thumbnail/footer) via modal

edit-message.description: Edit embed message text via modal (multi-line, more flexible than /set-message)

add-product.description: Add a new product to the price list

options.label: Product name (e.g. 7 Days, max 80 chars)
options.category: Product category (default: transaction). See /list-categories for the list.
options.requires_key: Does this product need Set Key? (default: true for key categories)

remove-product.description: Remove a product from the price list

update-product.description: Edit an existing product (label/price/category/requires_key) without delete+re-add

options.value: The product value to update (identifier — cannot be changed)
options.label: New product label (max 80 chars)
options.requires_key: Does this product need Set Key? (true=key, false=service/non-key)

remove-role.description: Remove a role from the config (verified / unverified / admin / midman / booster)

options.tipe: Choose the role type to remove

set-midman-fee.description: Set the escrow fee (percent of the deal price or a flat amount)

options.value: Fee value (percent: 0-90, flat: amount per deal). 0 = free

midman-deals.description: View all active escrow deals on this server

remove-channel.description: Remove a channel from the config (invoice / welcome / goodbye / audit-log / server-log / transcript)

options.tipe: Choose the channel type to remove

list-messages.description: View all current embed message texts

reset-message.description: Reset embed message text back to default

options.tipe: Choose which message to reset (or ALL for all of them)

reset-config.description: ⚠️ Delete ALL settings (roles, channels, messages) - cannot be undone!

set-product-role.description: Set a role & auto-expire duration for a specific product

options.role: The role granted when a purchase succeeds
options.days: Days before the role is automatically removed (0 = permanent)

remove-product-role.description: Remove the auto-role from a specific product

list-product-roles.description: View all product → role mappings + durations

set-key.description: Give a key to a user + grant role + extend schedule (MAX EXTEND)

options.key: The key to send to the user (max 200 chars)

list-keys.description: View all keys (active & expired) owned by the user

options.user: The user whose keys to view

clear-schedule.description: Clear all scheduled roles for a user (+ optionally delete all keys & remove the VIP role)

options.clear_keys: True = delete ALL user keys + remove the VIP role (full reset). Default: false.

setup-selfrole.description: Create a new self-role panel (members can take/drop roles themselves)

options.title: Panel title (e.g. Pick a Notif Role)
options.exclusive: True = only 1 role allowed at a time (e.g. color roles). Default false.

selfrole-add.description: Add a role to an existing self-role panel

options.panel_id: Panel ID (see /selfrole-list or the panel footer)
options.role: The role to add to the panel
options.label: Button / option label (max 80 chars)
options.requires_role: A role the user must have before taking this role (optional)

selfrole-remove.description: Remove a role from a self-role panel

options.role: The role to remove from the panel

selfrole-list.description: View all self-role panels in this guild

selfrole-delete.description: Delete a self-role panel (deletes the message + config)

announce.description: Quick announce — send an embed to a channel (1 command, 1 embed)

embed-builder.description: Interactive embed builder with live preview (for complex embeds)

embed-list.description: View all your active embed builder sessions (+ link to the draft message)

embed-cancel.description: Cancel an embed builder session by ID (if the draft got deleted/bugged)

backup-now.description: Create a manual backup now (config, keys, scheduledRoles, selfRoles, etc.)

backup-list.description: View all saved backups (max 7 most recent)

restore-backup.description: Restore a backup by name (auto-creates a safety backup before restoring)

giveaway.description: Manage community giveaways (create, list, end, reroll)

options.list: View all giveaways in this guild
options.end: End a giveaway early + pick winners
options.reroll: Reroll the winner of an ended giveaway

announce-schedule.description: Schedule an announcement to a channel at a specific time (one-shot or recurring)

announce-cancel.description: Cancel a scheduled announcement by ID

warn-list.description: View all warnings for a user

options.user: The user who owns the warning

warn-clear.description: Delete ALL warnings for a user

options.user: The user whose warnings to clear

timeout.description: Temporarily mute a member (max 28 days) — recorded in their history

options.duration: Duration in MINUTES (e.g. 60 = 1 hour, 1440 = 1 day, max 40320 = 28 days)
options.reason: Reason (sent to the member via DM)

options.user: The member whose timeout is lifted

purge.description: Bulk delete messages in a channel (1-100, only <14 days old)

options.user: Empty = all messages; set = only this user's messages

kick.description: Remove a member from the server (recorded in their history)

options.reason: Reason (sent to the member via DM)

ban.description: Ban a member + optionally delete 0-7 days of messages (recorded)

options.delete_days: Delete the member's messages from the last N days (0-7, default 0)
options.reason: Reason (sent to the member via DM)

unban.description: Revoke a ban by User ID (user need not be in the server)

options.user_id: User ID, 17-20 digits (Developer Mode → Copy User ID)

leaderboard.description: View the top 10 members (public — regular members can use it)

my-stats.description: View your personal stats (public — regular members can use it)

boosters.description: List the current server boosters + recent boost history (public)

test-booster.description: Diagnose & preview the boost add/remove notification (find out why it does not appear)

options.live: Also send the preview to the REAL server-booster channel (delivery test)

serverstats.description: Live counter channels (members, boosts…) that update automatically

options.setup: Create the counter category + live counter channels
options.remove: Delete the counter channels + category and clear the config

options.create: Create a new poll (modal input for options)
options.create.question: Poll question (max 250 chars)
options.create.multiple: True = members can pick multiple options. Default false (single)
options.list: View all polls in this guild
options.close: Close a poll + show the final results

setup-tempvoice.description: Set up temp voice — auto-creates a category + panel channel + trigger channel

tempvoice-remove.description: Remove the temp voice setup from the guild (category + all related channels are deleted)

send-message.description: Send a plain text message to a text channel (supports \n & mentions)

options.channel: Target channel (must be a text channel)
options.message: Message content (supports \n for newline). Max 2000 chars.

add-responder.description: Add an auto-responder: trigger keyword → auto reply

options.match_mode: How the trigger matches a message (default: Contains)

set-automod.description: Configure auto-mod (spam, links, word filter, mention limit)

options.spam_threshold: Number of messages in the window that counts as spam (default: 5)

add-link-whitelist.description: Add a channel/role to the link whitelist (allowed to post links)

add-word.description: Add words to the auto-mod blocklist/exempt (append, not replace)

options.action: Action specific to these words (empty = use the global word_action)

remove-word.description: Remove 1 word from the auto-mod blocklist/exempt

list-words.description: View the blocklist + exempt word lists + per-word actions

remove-link-whitelist.description: Remove a channel/role from the link whitelist

options.channel: The channel to remove from the whitelist
options.role: The role to remove from the whitelist

afk.description: Set AFK status (bot auto-replies when you get mentioned)

options.reason: AFK reason (supports \n, e.g. "Eating, back in 30 minutes")

afk-list.description: View all members who are currently AFK

options.announce_levelup: Announce when a user levels up? (default: true)

add-level-role.description: Add a reward role for a specific level (auto-assigned on level-up)

remove-level-role.description: Remove the reward role for a specific level

options.level: The level to remove the role from

rank.description: View your level & XP (or another user)

leaderboard-level.description: Top 10 members with the highest level (public)

set-language.description: Set the bot's reply language for this server (default: auto — follows each user's Discord language)

options.bahasa: Choose the language (Auto = follow each user's Discord app language)

replies.set_auto:
🌍 **Language saved: Auto.**

Each member now gets replies in their own Discord app language (English for languages the bot does not speak yet).
replies.set_fixed:
🌍 **Language saved: {language}.**

Every reply on this server now uses this language, regardless of each member's Discord app language.

header.no_servers: No servers found. Make sure CHRONOS-bot is invited to a server you manage.
